questions.q: Which of the following blood vessels carry blood away from the heart?
questions.qPa: ਹੇਠ ਲਿਖਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਖੂਨ ਦੀਆਂ ਨਾੜਾਂ ਖੂਨ ਨੂੰ ਦਿਲ ਤੋਂ ਦੂਰ ਲੈ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ?
questions.explanation: Arteries carry blood away from the heart, while veins bring it back.

questions.q: What is the only artery in the human body that carries deoxygenated blood?
questions.qPa: ਮਨੁੱਖੀ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕੋ-ਇੱਕ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਧਮਨੀ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਆਕਸੀਜਨ ਰਹਿਤ ਖੂਨ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: The Pulmonary Artery carries deoxygenated blood from the right ventricle to the lungs.

questions.q: The amount of blood pumped by the heart in one minute is called:
questions.explanation: Cardiac Output is the total volume of blood pumped per minute (Heart Rate x Stroke Volume).

questions.q: The tiny air sacs in the lungs where gas exchange occurs are called:
questions.explanation: Alveoli are the microscopic sacs surrounded by capillaries where O2 enters the blood and CO2 leaves.

questions.q: The maximum volume of air a person can exhale after a maximal inhalation is known as:
questions.qPa: ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਹ ਲੈਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਵੱਧ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਜਿੰਨੀ ਹਵਾ ਬਾਹਰ ਕੱਢ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਸਨੂੰ ਕੀ ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Vital Capacity is a key indicator of respiratory health and fitness.

questions.q: A normal resting blood pressure reading is approximately:
questions.explanation: 120/80 mmHg is considered the standard normal resting blood pressure.

questions.q: The phenomenon where an athlete suddenly feels easier breathing and relief from fatigue during prolonged exercise is called:
questions.explanation: Second Wind occurs when the body's aerobic system fully catches up to the exercise demands.

questions.q: Which blood vessels contain valves to prevent the backflow of blood?
questions.explanation: Veins have one-way valves because blood is returning to the heart under lower pressure, often fighting gravity.
